description.en: A DSH Web plugin that keeps a real-time outline in sync with the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 实时同步对话大纲的插件。

description.en: A Tauri 2 and Vanilla TypeScript Windows desktop launcher that starts or embeds dsh web, checks and upgrades DSH, and provides a 3.03 MB Windows installer.
description.zh: 基于 Tauri 2 和 Vanilla TypeScript 的 Windows 桌面启动器，可启动或嵌入 dsh web，检查并升级 DSH，并提供 3.03 MB 的 Windows 安装包。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that summarizes files written during a session and compares the workspace with HEAD for review.
description.zh: 用于汇总 DSH Web 会话文件写入，并将工作区与 HEAD 对比以便审阅的插件。

description.en: Enhances the DSH @ menu to reference commands, skills, files, DSH sessions, and external chatbot conversations.
description.zh: 增强 DSH @ 菜单，统一引用命令、Skills、文件、DSH 会话与外部 Chatbot 平台对话。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next), keyboard model switching, alternate send, and archive confirmation, with every binding rebindable via Windows/macOS presets.
description.zh: 会话热键：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理 DSH Web 会话（Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、键盘模型切换与备用发送），键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

description.en: Results-only view toggle for the DSH Web GUI: folds thinking and tool-call process rows so conversations show only user messages and final replies, with live summary chips for running steps, a click-to-expand turn trace with hover-peek, auto/manual fold modes, and context-injection rows folded too.
description.zh: DSH Web 的「只看结果」开关：折叠思考与工具调用过程行，对话只留用户消息与最终回复；运行中显示实时摘要芯片，回合后痕迹行可点击展开并支持悬停预览、自动/手动折叠，上下文注入行同样折叠。

description.en: Xianxia desktop companion pets for DSH Web: MC-pixel pets appear as subagents spawn (up to 3 on screen), with a storage bag, right-click artifact menu, a pet gallery, and Codex pet-format export.
description.zh: 修仙陪伴桌宠：MC 像素风桌宠与 agent 会话实时联动，子代理启动时化身宠物现身（最多 3 只同屏），支持储物袋收藏、右键法宝菜单与图鉴选宠，可导出 Codex 桌宠格式。

description.en: Automatic retrospective after agent sessions: distills useful experience into reusable skills in the skill library, with approval mode and archive/restore governance that never deletes directly.
description.zh: 自动复盘：会话收尾后自动把有价值经验蒸馏成可复用技能存入技能库，支持审批模式与归档/恢复治理，不直接删除技能。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes failures by type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) into backoff retry, model switch, resume after compaction, or stop-loss notification.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由到退避重试、换模型、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知。

description.en: Customizes the native DSH settings window: preset or custom sizes, fullscreen, background transparency and backgrounds (theme, color, or image), with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，配置存本机浏览器。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that turns the whole page into another host's DSH Web GUI reached over a loopback port (ssh -L, or frpc stcp/xtcp), with a state dot showing whether that remote is running, has new activity, or is waiting for you.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行「远程」，点击后整页切换成另一台主机的 DSH Web GUI（经回环端口访问，如 ssh -L 或 frpc stcp/xtcp），该行显示对端状态：运行中、有新活动或正在等待你回答。

description.en: A DSH plugin that carries a small continuity pointer across a session boundary: at the start of a new session it names the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file. It calls no model.
description.zh: 在新会话开头注入一条很小的接续指针：上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要，不调用模型。

description.en: A DSH settings panel that browses and one-click installs third-party plugins from a catalogue whose membership is decided by machine-checking the dsh.bundle.patch declaration in each candidate's package.json, rather than by star count.
description.zh: DSH 设置页里的插件索引：收录与否由机器校验每个候选仓库 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle.patch 声明决定，而不是看星数，支持一键安装。

description.en: A DSH skill manager: 6 built-in skills plus a 20-skill Chinese engineering pack (requirements grilling, ticketing, TDD, two-axis code review, retro), grouped by the situation you are in. Upgrading a pack never overwrites files you edited.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：自带 6 个基础技能与 20 个中文工程流程技能包（拷问需求、拆票、TDD、双轴代码审查、复盘），按「你遇到的问题」分组；升级技能包不会覆盖你改过的文件。
